name: Thunderbolt
body:
School evocation [air]; Level bard 3, druid/shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target 1 creature
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You blast your target with a thundering roar. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack. On a hit, you deal 1d6 hp sonic damage per caster level (max 10d6). Regardless of whether you hit, all creatures within 15 ft. of the target, including the target itself, must succeed on a Fortitude save or be deafened for 1 min.

Mythic: The damage increases to 1d8 hp sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d8 hp). Regardless of whether your range touch attack hits, all creatures within 30 ft. of the target (including the target) must make a Fortitude save or become deafened. That condition can only be cured with remove blindness/deafness or a similar effect.

Augmented (4th): You can spend an additional three uses of mythic power to deal half damage to the spell’s target even if the range touch attack misses, as long as that miss is not the result of rolling of a natural 1.
